chunks: He said: Abu al-Hasan Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn al-Hasan reported to me, he said: My father narrated to me, from Sa'd ibn Abdillah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub who said: Yahya ibn Abdillah ibn al-Hasan narrated to me, he said: I heard Ja'far ibn Muhammad, peace be upon them both, say while people of Kufa were with him:

"It is surprising to hear people claim that they derived all their knowledge from the Messenger of God, may God bless him and his family, and acted upon it and were guided, yet they believe that we, the Ahl al-Bayt, did not derive his knowledge nor were guided by it, though we are his family and his descendants! The revelation was sent down in our homes, and from us knowledge went out to the people.
Do you then think that they knew and were guided, while we remained ignorant and went astray?! Indeed, this is impossible."

key_terms.أهل البيت: Ahl al-Bayt, the People of the House -- the Prophet's immediate family, specifically the Imams from his lineage
key_terms.الوحي: al-Wahy, divine revelation sent down through the Prophet

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Sadiq say about the knowledge of the Ahl al-Bayt?
ai.summary: Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (AS) delivered this statement in the presence of people from Kufa, expressing astonishment at those who claim others derived all their knowledge from the Prophet (SAWW) and were guided, yet deny that the Ahl al-Bayt -- who are the Prophet's own family and descendants, in whose homes the revelation descended -- had access to the same knowledge. The Imam concludes that such a proposition is logically impossible.
